config.wolves-hunt-enemies.title: Wolves Hunt Enemies
config.wolves-hunt-enemies.attack_radius: Distance within which a wolf will detect and attack enemies.
How far a wolf will chase an enemy before giving up.
config.wolves-hunt-enemies.pack_spread.t: When enabled, wolves spread out and each target a different enemy. When disabled, all wolves focus the closest enemy.
config.wolves-hunt-enemies.path_back.too: When enabled, wolves will walk back to you instead of teleporting.
config.wolves-hunt-enemies.loot_pickup.t: When enabled, items dropped by enemies killed by your wolves will be picked up for you.
config.wolves-hunt-enemies.experience_pi: When enabled, XP dropped by enemies killed by your wolves is collected for you.
